verses.t: “Ayoni suddhimanvesaṁ, aggiṁ paricariṁ vane; Suddhimaggaṁ ajānanto, akāsiṁ amaraṁ tapaṁ.
Taṁ sukhena sukhaṁ laddhaṁ, passa dhammasudhammataṁ; Tisso vijjā anuppattā, kataṁ buddhassa sāsanaṁ.
Brahmabandhu pure āsiṁ, idāni khomhi brāhmaṇo; Tevijjo nhātako camhi, sottiyo camhi vedagū”ti. … Aṅgaṇikabhāradvājo thero ….
